subject: Greenline Health — post-demo recap, security gates & procurement path
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@greenlinehealth.com>, Tom Briggs <tom.briggs@greenlinehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-01T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Greenline Health — post-demo recap, security gates & procurement path

Hi Erin / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the demo this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned: 

What we covered
- Demo focus: low-latency inference for clinical prompts, PHI-safe routing, and audit traces for regulator review.
- Key concerns raised: SOC 2 evidence, data residency, egress controls, and procurement timeline.
- Economic signals: Tom noted a pilot budget (Q3) and potential production in Q4 pending security sign-off and legal terms.

Open asks / proposed next steps
1) Erin: Can you confirm who on your side will own the security checklist (SOC 2 / encrypted at-rest keys / audit logs)?
2) Tom: Please confirm the expected pilot scope (users, tokens/day) so we can size Dedicated capacity and an estimated run-rate.
3) Procurement: If you could loop in the procurement contact we’ll share standard SOW + pricing and a draft MSA with redline guidance.

I’ll attach a short champion playbook and a SOC 2 one-pager for your security team to scan. If helpful, we can do a 30-min legal + procurement sync next week.

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Greenline_Champion_Playbook.pdf (2 pages), SOC2-summary-2026.pdf (1 page)
From: Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@greenlinehealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Tom Briggs <tom.briggs@greenlinehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-02T09:58:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Greenline Health — post-demo recap, security gates & procurement path

Thanks Aditya — helpful recap. A few notes from security: 

- I own the security checklist; I’ll run your SOC 2 one-pager by our compliance team. Please include the SOC 2 report reference number and what controls relate to data retention and encryption key management.
- We also need a statement on data residency options (US-only), plus an outline of how audit logs are retained and exported for our auditors.
- Procurement: sanctioning contact is procurement@greenlinehealth.com (you can copy me). They will require our standard security addendum and DPAs.

I’m happy to join a 30-min procurement/contract sync next Tue or Wed afternoon.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-02T11:10:00-07:00
Subject: INTERNAL: Champion kit + talk tracks for Erin/Tom

Aditya — quick internal draft for the champion handoff. Paste into your outbound email or share as Drive link.

Champion one-pager (talk tracks)
- Value: Reduce per-call inference cost by ~60% using batching + prefix cache; estimated pilot run-rate $2.4k/mo (see ROICalc).
- Risk mitigation: SOC 2 in-place; we’ll provide SOC 2 summary + controls mapping (attached), key rotation via customer KMS or Redwood-managed HSM per preference.
- Ask for champion: intro to procurement contact + confirmation of pilot acceptance criteria (latency < 250ms p95, 80% uptime).

Procurement/Legal bullets (short answers to expect)
- MSA: standard Redwood MSA with Data Processing Addendum; typical redlines: termination for convenience, SLAs, and liability cap.
- Pricing: pilot discount available for first 3 months; committed Dedicated pricing for production.

Attachments to include outbound: Greenline_Champion_Playbook.pdf, SOC2-summary-2026.pdf, ROICalc-Greenline.xlsx

LMK if you want a 1-pager version (I can cut this down to one page).

—Marissa
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@greenlinehealth.com>, procurement@greenlinehealth.com
Cc: Tom Briggs <tom.briggs@greenlinehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-02T13:30:00-07:00
Subject: Greenline Health — procurement gate & shared artifacts (SOC2, champion playbook)

Hi Erin / Procurement —

Per Erin’s note, looping in procurement to start the contracting track. Short package attached: 
- Greenline_Champion_Playbook.pdf — internal sell-in kit for your stakeholders (product fit, ROI bullets, pilot acceptance criteria).
- SOC2-summary-2026.pdf — high-level controls mapping (we will share the full report under NDA).
- ROICalc-Greenline.xlsx — simple run-rate model and pilot pricing estimate.

Proposed procurement path & timeline (suggested):
1) Procurement reviews attached SOW + SOC summary (this week)
2) Legal & Security review (security to confirm controls mapping and any DPA changes)
3) Pilot SOW execution via DocuSign (target: by 2027-04-15)

Can procurement confirm the correct intake email and any special PO / invoicing requirements? Also, Erin — if you can confirm which additional security artifacts you need (e.g., penetration test report), we’ll prioritize those.

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Greenline_Champion_Playbook.pdf, SOC2-summary-2026.pdf, ROICalc-Greenline.xlsx
From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@greenlinehealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@greenlinehealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-03T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Greenline Health — procurement gate & shared artifacts (SOC2, champion playbook)

Aditya — thanks for the materials. Procurement next steps: 

- Confirmed intake: procurement@greenlinehealth.com (we received the attachments).
- Please complete the procurement intake form linked here: https://greenlineprocure/submit (we need estimated spend, billing entity, and PO terms).
- Our standard flow: procurement review (3 business days), then routing to legal for MSAs (5–7 business days). If everything is standard, we’ll push the DocuSign SOW and reference number next.

I’ve attached the initial DocuSign packet link: https://app.docusign.com/1234-GLH-procurement — feel free to prepare the SOW draft so we can expedite.

Sanjay Patel
Procurement Coordinator
Greenline Health
